Password-envelope dependencies

The bundled filekit-crypto.js contains selected modules from:
- @noble/curves 2.4.0
- @noble/hashes 2.4.0
- @noble/ciphers 2.4.0
Copyright Paul Miller and contributors, licensed under MIT. The corresponding
license texts are included in this directory.

The small application adapter and pinned npm lock file are in the
accompanying Michiflin source tree under tools/filekit_crypto. To rebuild, run
npm ci and npm run build there with Node 20.19 or later.
